name: Frisée

companions.note: Mild pest deterrence; similar cool-season timing

pnw_notes: Best sown August–September for a fall and winter harvest. Dislikes heat — summer sowings bolt quickly. The white, tender heart forms naturally as outer leaves shade it. Self-seeds readily in mild winters.

frost_hardiness.notes: More frost-tolerant than lettuce. Row cover below 28°F. The pale inner heart is more cold-sensitive than the outer leaves.

planting_windows.notes: Primary fall window — cooler temps prevent bolting; thin to 12 in
Harvest outer leaves continuously; pale inner heart forms naturally as outer leaves shade it
